reason: Entries: the label only (JSR from check_in_full/friends_in_full/search_in_full, BEQ from check_for_player_collision_with_mover_Y with X=0, fall-through from check_for_mover_collision_with_mover_X); no label+N reference; leave_* labels keep their code and kill_mover's branches to leave_with_carry_clear_28c9 keep their distance. The four tests are side-effect-free and ANDed, so reordering keeps C on every exit; the right-edge arithmetic is identical (type inlined exactly as get_mover_X_type_and_height computes it, width by that type); y+height is the same 8-bit sum (C=0 after the untaken BCS in the old, CLC in the new, height from the same routine incl. the skeleton case). X preserved (the JSR'd routine does not touch X). Stack depth at most one JSR as before. A, Y, &78, &7A differ on exit: every direct caller and every loop exit was checked (check_for_collision_after_horizontal/vertical_move reload via check_for_hostile_collision's LDY / not_hostile's LDX/LDA; kill_mover LDY &87; &92 and hostile_mover reloads; check_if_friendly LDY; search_for_target callers LDY mover_to_update; friends -> consider_mover_firing_grenade -> not_throwing_grenade/consider_mover_firing_bullet reload Y/X; update loop reloads); &78 aliases (y_offset, y_velocity, colour, right_high, initial_new_movers_offset, ranks_remaining) and &7A (plot_mover's STA &7A first; check_if_mover_is_on_edge has no caller) are written before read; no interrupt code reads them. Recount from the measured split (5,213 fail x_max of which ~404 also failed the old right edge, 6,000 fail right edge, 93 fail y_max, 1,954 reach the height, which now cost ~5 more): ~427 cycles a pass, ~32 a check with mover_x_max_low/high in zero page (claim 32/425; page crossings aside). Code grows 4 bytes (56 vs 52), the claim's -4. Stale note: the range loop's comment about leaving A, Y, &78, &7A as the original did no longer holds (already untrue of A/Y before this candidate).
